svg.text: History polishing forecasts | seed_28101 | first 6 trajectories
Gray: raw noisy history; colored history: actual supplied input; dashed black: noisy future target.
Colored future: forecast mean; shading: empirical central 90% interval. Vertical divider: forecast boundary. No clean signals.
